tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background and text on `blue`, `blue-dark` and `black`.

tokens.name: gray-light
tokens.usage: Light gray surface: `ContentCard` on a `white` page, code blocks, the `dimmed` block style.

tokens.name: gray
tokens.usage: Borders, hairlines and disabled states. Marked "use?" in the sketch: only 3.5:1 on white, so never for text.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Body text on `white`, `gray-light`, `blue-light`, `yellow-light` and `yellow`.

tokens.name: blue-light
tokens.usage: Lightest blue: small accents only. Never a section background (2026-10-30: use `yellow-light` instead). Text on it: `black` or `blue`.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Web blue: headings, links, the primary action (buttons, Let's talk), focus outlines, the logo grid ground. 8.6:1 with white text.

tokens.name: blue-dark
tokens.usage: Darkest blue: the Tech menu pill, the `HeroHeader` of tech pages and tech `ContentCard` ground, pressed states. Everything on it is `white`: text, labels, arrows, lines. Never `yellow`.

tokens.name: yellow-light
tokens.usage: Light yellow: the `HeroHeader` and `HomeHero` ground and the one coloured section ground.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow: large fields, the logo world. Text on it: `black` (16:1) or `blue`.

tokens.name: yellow-dark
tokens.usage: Dark yellow. Never a background (Sjoerd, 2026-11-10); no assigned use yet.

tokens.name: soft-red
tokens.usage: Form errors: error message text and invalid input border/outline. 3.5:1 on `white`: pair the message with its text, never colour alone (source pair kept as is).

families.sans: "apercu", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, Verdana, sans-serif
families.code: Consolas, Menlo, Monaco, "Andale Mono", "Ubuntu Mono", monospace

groups.name: Type styles
groups.note: Styles scale linearly with the viewport between a 320px and a 1100px width (clamp()), except `small`, which is fixed at 16px: no text is smaller. Line heights are unitless.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section heading, card titles, quotes. `blue`. Fluid, 24px–33px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text; also inputs and buttons. Fluid, 16px–18px.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Form labels, table cells, small buttons, dates, captions, meta. Fixed at 16px, the smallest text size on the site.

spacing.note: A 5-based scale named after its px value: steps of 5 up to 20, then 30/60/120 and 40/80/160.

tokens.name: spacing-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its input; list item gaps; small offsets.

tokens.name: spacing-10
tokens.usage: Button groups, tight gaps, the gap between a card arrow and its title.

tokens.name: spacing-15
tokens.usage: Input field top margin; list indent on small screens; gaps inside small components.

tokens.name: spacing-20
tokens.usage: Padding inside compact components; gaps between related items.

tokens.name: spacing-30
tokens.usage: Card padding and card grid gaps; between stacked fields; between a heading and its text.

tokens.name: spacing-40
tokens.usage: Between content blocks inside a section; under a block title.

tokens.name: spacing-60
tokens.usage: Between a section heading and a wide module.

tokens.name: spacing-80
tokens.usage: Between page blocks below 1100px (`block-spacing`).

tokens.name: spacing-120
tokens.usage: Between page blocks from 1100px (`block-spacing`).

tokens.name: spacing-160
tokens.usage: Largest vertical rhythm: page header spacing.

tokens.name: block-spacing
tokens.usage: The one vertical rhythm between page blocks: the gap between blocks (and between the page header and the first block), the top and bottom padding of a block on a coloured ground, and the space before the footer. `spacing-80`, `spacing-120` from 1100px (Sjoerd, 2026-11-10).

tokens.name: border-radius
tokens.usage: Filled buttons (primary and small) only. Every surface is square: cards, panels, images, inputs.

tokens.name: border-radius-pill
tokens.usage: The pill. It means one thing: a small clickable label (`TagList` tag, the Tech menu pill). Never on a surface or a static label.

tokens.name: box-shadow
tokens.usage: The only shadow: floating elements (the `MenuDropdown` panel, the `GlossaryTerm` popover). Cards have none.

layout.note: Grid and component dimensions from variables.css.

tokens.name: grid-margin
tokens.usage: Outer page margin column of the grid.

tokens.name: grid-gutter-large
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on large screens.

tokens.name: grid-column-small
tokens.usage: Fixed grid column width below 720px.

tokens.name: grid-column-medium
tokens.usage: Fixed grid column width from 720px.

tokens.name: grid-column-large
tokens.usage: Fixed grid column width from 1100px.

tokens.name: app-header-height-small
tokens.usage: Header height below 720px (50px).

tokens.name: app-header-height-large
tokens.usage: Header height from 720px (65px).

tokens.name: scroll-to-height

tokens.name: event-intro-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the event intro text.

zIndex.note: Local levels (base, raised) are used inside a component that isolates its stacking; page layers are 100 apart.

tokens.name: z-index-base
tokens.usage: Local: decoration drawn behind a component's content (button fill, accent panels). Only inside an isolated component.

tokens.name: z-index-raised
tokens.usage: Local: content or a link overlay lifted over its sibling inside a component.

tokens.name: z-index-sticky
tokens.usage: Page layer: sticky elements such as a table of contents or a reading bar.

tokens.name: z-index-header
tokens.usage: Page layer: AppHeader, above sticky content.

tokens.name: z-index-overlay
tokens.usage: Page layer: AppMobileMenu, dialogs, popovers and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-index-skip-link
tokens.usage: Page layer: the skip link, above everything when focused.
